summary: PR-1829 adds a single compatibility URL (GET /compat/account-number/{id}) that reuses the existing _reveal_account_number handler and the existing privileged action view_account_number with mfa=True. The route is registered in both routes.py and the HANDLERS map in app.py, and it flows through the same authentication, MFA, and RBAC checks as all other routes. The change touches only two non-protected files, has an approved standard ticket with correct component coverage, independent code_review and security_review approvals on the sole commit, and a clean CI run (172/172 passing) that includes the exhaustive MFA-1 control test. No product obligation is violated and no exception is needed; all process obligations are satisfied.
